_comment: Slot-fill phrase set for the structured-scene engine. Phrases compose deterministically per the grammar in SCHEMA.md. Voice: third-person past, Obra-Dinn-style — cold, observational, terse. Gender-neutral wherever a body or stance is described (no he/she pronouns in STANCE/TELL phrases). The detective is referred to as 'the detective' (en) / 'la detective' (es). Hospital case: clinical setting, fluorescent light, the long night.
